summary: PCA analysis and directed testing completed for DNF commit aeb975e5486fa3bb5cd7db9d35af1eebd4bc8e64 ("Support globs in usr_drift_protected_paths"). Analysis confirmed 1 INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE finding (HIGH priority): the patch changes usr_drift_protected_paths matching from prefix/exact matching (startswith/==) to fnmatch glob matching, causing 5 regression cases where bare directory paths lose subdirectory protection. Contract verification confirmed the behavioral change. Full integration testing blocked by missing DNF system libraries on host. Worktree cleaned.
